column3: Documentation URL (Optional, you can leave this field blank.)
column4: Status (Mandatory, can be one of the following numbers: 2 for Design, 4 for Production)
column5: Related Projects (Optional and accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a project, you can find them at Security Operations / Project Management.)
column6: Tags (Optional and accepts tags separated by "|". For example "Critical|Approved".)
column7: GRC Contact (Mandatory. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|" with a mandatory prefix. For example: Group-Admin|User-John). You can get the login of an user account from Settings / Organization & Access / Users or name of a group from Settings / Organization & Access / Groups.)
column8: Control Operator Contact (Mandatory. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|" with a mandatory prefix. For example: Group-Admin|User-John). You can get the login of an user account from Settings / Organization & Access / Users or name of a group from Settings / Organization & Access / Groups.)
column9: Cost (OPEX) (Optional, leave it empty or insert a numerical value.)
column10: Cost (CAPEX) (Optional, leave it empty or insert a numerical value.)
column11: Resource Utilization (Optional, leave it empty or insert a numerical value.)
column12: Related Policies (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You can get the name of a policy from Control Catalogue / Policy Management.)
column13: Audit Owner (Mandatory in case you set audit dates. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|". For User login use prefix "User-" and for Group name use "Group-". For example "User-admin|Group-Third Party Feedback|Group-Admin". You can get the login of an user account from System / Settings / User Management or name of a group from System / Settings / Groups.)
column14: Audit Evidence Owner (Mandatory in case you set audit dates. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|". For User login use prefix "User-" and for Group name use "Group-". For example "User-admin|Group-Third Party Feedback|Group-Admin". You can get the login of an user account from System / Settings / User Management or name of a group from System / Settings / Groups.)
column15: Audit Methodology (Mandatory in case you set audit dates, you need to insert some text or NA if you are not interested in this feature.)
column16: Audit Success Criteria (Mandatory in case you set audit dates, you need to insert some text or NA if you are not interested in this feature.)
column17: Audit Date (Optional, you can insert date with the format DD-MM, bare in mind the delimiter is a "-", Accepts multiple values separated by "|". For example "22-01|15-10".)
column18: Maintenance Owner (Mandatory in case you set maintenance dates. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|". For User login use prefix "User-" and for Group name use "Group-". For example "User-admin|Group-Third Party Feedback|Group-Admin". You can get the login of an user account from System / Settings / User Management or name of a group from System / Settings / Groups.)
column19: Maintenance Task (Mandatory in case you set maintenance dates, you can set NA if you wont want to use this feature.)
column20: Maintenance Date (Optional, you can insert date with the format DD-MM, bare in mind the delimiter is a "-", Accepts multiple values separated by "|". For example "22-01|15-10".)
